The average EU ETS allowance price was highest in June 2025.

ANSWER: June
sql: select avg(d.eua_price_eur_per_t) as value from marts.fct_daily_carbon_price d where year(d.date_key) >= 2025 and year(d.date_key) <= 2025

findings.text: The total number of ro-ro ships increased from 226 in 2023 to 243 in 2025, while vehicle carriers grew from 461 to 533 over the same period.
Ro-ro ship CO2 emissions decreased slightly from 5,469,398 tonnes in 2023 to 5,349,454 tonnes in 2025, whereas vehicle carrier emissions rose from 4,166,581 tonnes to 4,300,770 tonnes.
ETS costs for ro-ro ships reached 213,570,794 EUR in 2025, up from 107,653,764 EUR in 2024, while vehicle carrier ETS costs grew from 67,082,421 EUR to 136,165,586 EUR.
For ro-ro ships, carbon emissions steadily declined from 363.6 kg per nautical mile in 2021 to 340.2 kg per nautical mile in 2025.
Vehicle carriers emitted 310.9 kg of CO2 per nautical mile in 2021 and reached their lowest emission level of 287.1 kg per nautical mile in 2025.
Average speeds for ro-ro ships ranged between 14.31 and 14.89 knots over the five-year period, while vehicle carriers operated between 13.91 and 14.35 knots.
In 2025, vehicle carriers had a higher share of top carbon ratings at 32.5% compared to 26.1% for ro-ro ships.
Vehicle carriers with poor carbon ratings of D or E decreased from 43.0% in 2023 to 37.8% in 2025.
The total number of rated ship-years for vehicle carriers grew from 416 in 2023 to 431 in 2025.
Stavanger recorded the highest number of port calls on the Norwegian coast with 87 visits between August and September 2026.
Drammen registered the longest median berth time among the top ports at 8.5 hours.
All listed ports reported a 0.0 percent share of calls experiencing waiting time.
The average EU ETS allowance price rose from EUR 15.98 per tonne in 2018 to EUR 85.30 per tonne in 2023.
The highest recorded allowance price reached a peak of EUR 100.34 per tonne in 2023.
In 2024, the average allowance price decreased to EUR 66.58 per tonne before increasing to EUR 79.11 per tonne by 2026.
The total CO2 emissions from Ro-ro ships decreased by 2.5% from 2023 to 2025, while vehicle carriers saw a 2.1% increase in emissions over the same period.
The average ETS cost per Ro-ro ship increased by 85.5% from 2023 to 2025, while vehicle carriers saw a 100.3% increase in ETS cost over the same period.
The number of ships in the Ro-ro segment increased by 4.7% from 2023 to 2025, while vehicle carriers saw a 15.4% increase in the number of ships over the same period.
